notes: Exact-unit-commitment capacity-expansion MILP on the small timor_demo dataset, given 30 s on HiGHS (it needs ~25 min). The engine prints 'Capacity expansion reached the time limit' and still extracts the incumbent. The problem itself is fine; only the search budget is wrong, so the correct fix is Tier A: raise time_limit (~1800 s) or switch solver to gurobi. relax_uc=true (Tier B) would also finish but changes the problem from a MILP to its LP relaxation.
